connector.name: Keycloak Admin
connector.registryDescription: Administer Keycloak via its Admin REST API: users, roles, clients, groups, IdP, events.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-keycloak-admin. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mrz1880 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: KEYCLOAK_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Keycloak server (no trailing slash).

env.name: KC_ADMIN_REALM
env.description: Realm holding the admin user (password mode; default master).

env.name: READ_ONLY
env.description: When true, write and destructive tools are not registered.

env.name: ALLOWED_REALMS
env.description: Comma-separated allow-list of realms the server may operate on.
